purpose: Cover US-18002 (the Readiness tab renders question cards grouped by source span): the questions block lists each group with its asks and every id is in the JSON (AC-18002-1), the empty questions set renders the intent-complete verdict line (AC-18002-2), and engineer blockers are never removed from the DOM in any register (AC-18002-3). Points at the three AC tests under test/view/readiness-po-layer.test.js.
title: Readiness PO question cards: groups and asks, intent-complete empty state, engineer DOM preserved across registers

testCases.description: renderReadinessPO is given a readiness object with questions[] non-empty; every group label, every ask and every question id appears in the panel, and data-rcf-source="readiness.questions" is stamped so the source path is unambiguous.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-po-layer.test.js::PO layer: AC-18002-1 given questions[] non-empty, the block lists each group with its asks and every id is in the JSON

testCases.description: renderReadinessPO is given a clean readiness object with both levels ok and no blockers; the panel renders the exact intent-complete verdict line (formatVerdictLines(result).intentComplete) inside the questions block and marks the section data-rcf-empty="yes".
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-po-layer.test.js::PO layer: AC-18002-2 given questions[] empty, the block shows the intent-complete verdict line

testCases.description: renderReadinessPanel across every register (null / productOwner / engineer) keeps every engineer blocker id in the DOM, keeps every PO blocker id in the DOM and renders the CLI verdict strings verbatim inside the For-engineers DocRow; the For-engineers DocRow is closed under productOwner / unstated and open under engineer.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/readiness-po-layer.test.js::PO layer: AC-18002-3 engineer blockers are not removed from the DOM in any register
